article.title: The German Democratic Republic, a socialist state still villainized long after its demise
article.author: Editor
article.content: Oct. 7, 2024, marks the 75th anniversary of the founding of the German Democratic Republic. For several years in the 1980s, People’s World Editor John Wojcik served as chair of the U.S. Committee for Friendship with the GDR.
